en: Oh, in the meadow the red guelder rose has bent down low,
For some reason our glorious Ukraine has grown sorrowful.
And we shall raise that red guelder rose up,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
And we shall raise that red guelder rose up,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
Do not bend down, red guelder rose, you have white blossom,
Do not grieve, glorious Ukraine, you have a free people.
And we shall raise that red guelder rose up,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
And we shall raise that red guelder rose up,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
Our volunteers are marching into the bloody dance,
To free our Ukrainian brothers from Muscovite chains.
And we shall free our Ukrainian brothers,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
And we shall free our Ukrainian brothers,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
Oh, in the field, a golden stretch of spring wheat,
The Ukrainian riflemen have begun the dance with the enemies.
And we shall gather in that spring wheat,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
And we shall gather in that spring wheat,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
When the wild wind blows from the wide steppes,
It will make the Sich Riflemen famous all over Ukraine.
And we shall keep that riflemen's glory,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
And we shall keep that riflemen's glory,
And we shall, hey, hey, make our glorious Ukraine merry!
rom: Oj u luzi červona kalyna poxylylasja,
Čohosʹ naša slavna Ukrajina zažurylasja.
A my tuju červonu kalynu pidijmemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
A my tuju červonu kalynu pidijmemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
Ne xylysja, červona kalyno, maješ bilyj cvit,
Ne žurysja, slavna Ukrajino, maješ vilʹnyj rid.
A my tuju červonu kalynu pidijmemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
A my tuju červonu kalynu pidijmemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
Maršyrujutʹ naši dobrovolʹci u kryvavyj tan,
Vyzvoljaty brativ-ukrajinciv z moskovsʹkyx kajdan.
A my našyx brativ-ukrajinciv vyzvolymo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
A my našyx brativ-ukrajinciv vyzvolymo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
Oj u poli jaroji pšenyčky zolotystyj lan,
Rozpočaly strilʹci ukrajinsʹki z vorohamy tan.
A my tuju jaruju pšenyčku izberemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
A my tuju jaruju pšenyčku izberemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
Jak povije bujnesenʹkyj viter z šyrokyx stepiv,
To proslavytʹ po vsij Ukrajini sičovyx strilʹciv.
A my tuju strilecʹkuju slavu zberežemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
A my tuju strilecʹkuju slavu zberežemo,
A my našu slavnu Ukrajinu, hej-hej, rozveselymo!
notes: Romanization: ь is written ʹ, х is written x.
line 1.1: 'калина' is the guelder rose (Viburnum opulus), a bush with red berries and white flowers, a symbol of Ukraine.
line 3.1: 'тан' is a dance; 'the bloody dance' is battle.
line 5.1: 'буйнесенький' is an endearing intensive of 'буйний', wild, unruly.
line 5.2: the Sich Riflemen (січові стрільці), the Ukrainian volunteer legion of 1914.
